user.title: Add an OVAPI favourite
user.description: Find a stop by town and name. Then choose the stop sign or direction. OVAPI uses public, unencrypted HTTP; coverage varies. For NS trains, use the separate Nederlandse Spoorwegen integration.

data_description.name: Your label, such as Amsterdam Amstel.
data_description.lines: Optional comma-separated public line numbers, matched exactly.
data_description.walking_minutes: Used by the companion cards to calculate when to leave.

reconfigure.title: Change the favourite
reconfigure.description: Change the stop, label or filters. Connection validation shares the global request budget.

menu_options.search: Find a different stop by name
menu_options.manual: Edit the name or timing-point code (advanced)

data_description.name: Your label for this favourite.
data_description.walking_minutes: Walking time for local leave countdowns.

manual.title: Enter a timing-point code
manual.description: Advanced fallback for a known code. Leading zeros matter. Validation shares the polling budget; after another request, wait at least two minutes before retrying.

search.title: Find a stop
search.description: Enter a town and part of the stop name, for example Amsterdam Amstel. Search uses a temporary local directory, not a request for each keystroke.

area.title: Choose a stop
area.description: Choose the town and stop name. Next, available stop signs or directions will load. Codes distinguish identical names.

point.title: Choose your stop sign
point.description: Choose a timing point using the names, lines and destinations supplied by OVAPI. These are examples of current information, not all services. Without current departure information, the direction and transport mode may be unknown. No departures does not mean no service.

data_description.name: Your own label for this favourite.
data_description.stop_id: Codes distinguish stop signs where source descriptions are missing.
data_description.walking_minutes: Used by the companion cards to calculate when to leave.

retry.title: Stop lookup needs attention
retry.description: Retry waits automatically for the shared request budget. You can also search again or enter a known code.

progress.lookup: Loading from OVAPI. Normal setup has no timed wait. All setup windows share two lookup requests per two minutes; extra lookups may need to wait. Server errors can require a longer pause. This continues automatically; close to cancel.

error.short_query: Enter at least two characters, or choose advanced code entry.
error.invalid_walk: Enter a whole number of walking minutes from 0 to 120.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach OVAPI. The integration will back off; try again later.
error.unknown_stop: OVAPI did not return this stop. Check its timing-point code.
error.invalid_stop: Enter a timing-point code containing 1-10 digits.
error.invalid_data: OVAPI returned invalid or ambiguous data. Try again later.
error.response_too_large: OVAPI returned more data than the safety limit allows. Retry later or use a known code; do not repeatedly reload.
error.unknown_area: OVAPI did not return this stop area. Search again or use a known code.
error.invalid_area: This stop-area identifier is invalid. Search again.
error.no_matches: No matching stop metadata was found. Try a town or shorter name. This is not evidence that there are no services.
error.too_many_matches: Too many stops match. Add a town or more of the stop name.
error.no_points: No usable timing points were returned for this area. Retry later, search again or use a known code. This does not mean there are no services.
error.selection_expired: The temporary stop information expired. Retry to load fresh choices.
error.discovery_busy: Too many stop lookups are open. Close another setup window and retry.
error.rate_limited: The shared request budget is cooling down or OVAPI requested a pause. Wait at least two minutes before retrying.
error.too_many_stops: At most ten distinct timing points are supported per Home Assistant instance.

abort.already_configured: This stop and filter combination is already configured.
abort.discovery_busy: Too many stop lookups are open. Close another setup window and try again.

init.title: Favourite preferences
init.description: Filters and walking time do not increase upstream request frequency.
